project.label: Authorized adversarial-Agent laboratory
project.thesis: Study autonomous opposition by keeping actor intent and observation, authority, physical consequence, sensor evidence, world truth, and evaluation as distinct facts.
project.question: Which Agent-native laws remain necessary when autonomous actors can adapt, deceive, request consequential in-range effects, and continue across controller failure?
owns: Range authority and adversarial effect admission
Independent world truth, evidence, replay, and closure
boundary: Authorized owned or explicitly delegated ranges only
No generic Host, Harness, Runtime, hypervisor, or security-tool ownership
No unrestricted external targets or production attack-platform claim
project.problem: Classical security mechanisms can execute, observe, and contain effects, but they do not by themselves define the experiment when autonomous opponents hold different observations, authority, objectives, and interpretations of the same changing world.
project.capability: Runs bounded adversarial experiments through a stable synchronous Contest profile and an experimental persistent RangeSession spine, composing model Actors, CAGE, isolated Windows/Linux range materializations, exact RangeAuthority, independent truth, interruption recovery, and residual closure without turning receipts or actor claims into world truth.
project.maturity: Executable bounded research with experimental 0.8 interfaces and accepted physical range evidence
project.audience: Security and Agent researchers studying autonomous opposition, authority, deception, contested observation, consequence recovery, evaluator integrity, and cross-fidelity transfer.
project.latestProof: C1-K showed that an exact declarative ensure-state consequence can tolerate ACK loss and repeated physical invocation while producing one semantic consequence: already-satisfied exact state is a successful recovery result. C1-L then showed compensation is a separate recovery primitive for non-idempotent effects when repair progress remains independently observable; blind compensation retry can overcompensate, so recovery must re-observe the repair invariant before acting.
project.summary: An authorized adversarial-Agent research laboratory. Security owns contested-world semantics and evidence interpretation while mature hypervisors, ranges, model Harnesses, process runtimes, and security tools retain their own authority.
project.state: The 0.8 research core is active. Contest remains the reproducible synchronous profile; RangeSession is the experimental persistent-world spine. S0–S6 and C1–C1L have produced accepted bounded evidence. The recovery line now distinguishes information loss, intrinsic idempotency, and compensation: exactly-once invocation is unnecessary for some declarative effects, while non-idempotent consequences can sometimes be repaired without a transaction manager when repair progress is independently observable. The next pressure is compensation whose own progress becomes observationally ambiguous.
